summary_1line: Dadhimukha reports to Sugriva that Angada and the monkeys devastated Madhuvana; Sugriva deduces they must have succeeded in finding Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: The drunken Angada seizes Dadhimukha and hurls him to the ground while monkeys rampage through the honey-filled grove.
Bloodied and battered, Dadhimukha descends from the sky and bows before Sugriva, with Rama and Lakshmana watching beside him.
Sugriva, seated with Rama and Lakshmana, smiles knowingly as he realizes the monkeys must have found Sita.
